raw_text: The Border Security Force has shot down a Pakistani hexacopter drone near Amritsar carrying five kilograms of heroin, the third such incursion along the Punjab international border in a week. The drone was detected by ground sensors and engaged by BSF personnel in the early hours of Tuesday. Intelligence agencies suspect a narco-terror network operating from Pakistan's Kasur district, using commercially available drones to deliver narcotics payloads across the border. Anti-drone systems including laser-based countermeasures are being deployed at forward posts along the 553-km Punjab border.
clean_text: BSF shot down Pakistani drone with 5kg heroin near Amritsar. Third incursion in a week. Narco-terror network from Kasur suspected. Anti-drone systems including lasers deployed.
